run_motion_editor: run the biped motion editor demo by executing Editor.py to launch the AI4Animation scene
create_dataset_with_modules: create a Dataset with RootModule, MotionModule, ContactModule, GuidanceModule, and MirrorModule for biped motion editing
add_motion_editor_entity: add a MotionEditor entity to the AI4Animation scene using Scene.AddEntity
configure_contact_module: configure a ContactModule with ankle and ball joint contact parameters for left and right feet
set_camera_target: set the standalone camera target to the MotionEditor entity using Camera.SetTarget
